reason: Conversation 1 stays on the sensible path of settings and loading, and its final turn answers the 'is that normal?' question with a useful middle-shelf thermometer check (3-5C is fine, 1-2C or below points to an engineer). It also avoids unsupported claims and does not push the customer to empty the drawer for the model. Conversation 2 gives good first-step advice but pads it with irrelevant items (a defrost suggestion, seal checks), and its claim that MAX on an H8 model is 'often effectively run colder/harder' is speculative. It also ends before the follow-up, so it never covers the persisting yoghurt or when to escalate.
